title: eng-ml
text:
eng-ml

maria: heads up — ran the HF -> Redwood converter on elephant-7b-small and seeing token id jitter for special tokens, causing small but consistent eval regressions. BOS/EOS/PAD ids don't line up with the original HF bundle. anyone seen this?

kevin: hmm, we saw similar once when added_tokens.json was present. converter was appending added tokens to the vocab but not updating special token ids consistently. :thinking_face:

alyssa: can you paste the tokenizer config and the added_tokens.json snippet (or a quick output of tokenizer.convert_tokens_to_ids for special tokens)?

maria: here's the minimal repro info:
```json
{
  "bos_token": "<s>",
  "eos_token": "</s>",
  "pad_token": "<pad>",
  "bos_token_id": 0,
  "eos_token_id": 2,
  "pad_token_id": 1
}
```
and added_tokens.json contained a few web emojis + long wordpieces; after conversion the runtime tokenizer shows: `tokenizer.convert_tokens_to_ids(['<s>','</s>','<pad>'])` -> `[50256, 1, 2]` while HF original mapping was `[0,2,1]`. so ids shifted.

sam: that ordering would break anything that assumes bos_id==0 or pad_id==1. Quantized models especially — if embedding rows get shuffled relative to ids, kv-cache and embeddings mismatch. saw a ~4% PPL bump on wikitext in the eval run. :grimacing:

kevin: likely causes: (1) the tokenizer fast implementation reindexes when merging added_tokens, (2) our converter's merge step uses list.extend without remapping special ids, (3) or `tokenizer.add_special_tokens` was called after building vocab which shifts indices.

alyssa: short-term mitigation: remap stage in converter that matches tokens by string and writes new bos/eos/pad/unk ids into config.json, and reorders embedding matrix rows to match new ids. example check: `for t in ['<s>','</s>','<pad>']: assert tokenizer.convert_tokens_to_ids(t) == config['<token>_id']`

maria: tried the remap locally — patched converter to build an old->new id map by token string equality and then rewrite config.json special ids and permute the embedding matrix accordingly. After that quantized int8 model PPL returned to baseline. will run full eval suite tomorrow. :party_parrot:

sam: opened PR with the quick remap + unit test that compares token->id for all special tokens and a small corpus check. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/converter/pull/215 (WIP)

kevin: nice. also let's add a regression test where we import a HF model with added_tokens.json and ensure stable token ids across converter runs — to catch nondeterministic append-order issues.

maria: note for oncall/ops: if you see runtime errors like `index out of range for embedding` during rollout, this is likely the symptom — abort rollout and revert to previous model. i'll add a short runbook.

ops-bot: scheduled deploy for converter v0.3.4 to staging at 2026-03-22T07:00Z (includes remap patch). :white_check_mark:

alyssa: thanks — after staging evals pass we'll roll to dedicated and private images. anyone want to review the PR before EOD? @kevin @sam

kevin: i can take a look in ~2h.

maria: thanks all — will paste the failing eval plots in #eng-ml after the full run completes.
